# GitHub Wiki Branch Publisher

Publishes the entire documentation tree to a dedicated wiki branch using pure git plumbing, without affecting the user's working tree or the checked-out branch. Ensures the published branch reflects a complete snapshot and is force-pushed as the source of truth. Commits are only created for real changes, reducing noise and maintaining clarity for automated documentation workflows.
